messages:
ana: CI is red on eval-structured-ci for the new streaming JSON harness. Only failing on quantized runs rn.
ci-bot: job eval-structured-ci (runner/quantized-4bit) started -> https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/12345 :gear:
devin: stack trace shows parser error: \"Unexpected trailing characters at position 483\". Looks like the validator gets concatenated chunks.
mila: can you paste the raw stream excerpt?
ana: yep, from the failing log (trimmed):
```
STREAM CHUNK 1:\n{"id":"ex-1","predicted_tool_call":{"name":"geo_lookup","args":{"q":"latitude of redwood inference"},"meta":{"tok_count":42}}
STREAM CHUNK 2:\n,\n"confidence":0.93}\nSTREAM CHUNK 3:\n{"id":"ex-2","predicted_tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":{"q":"api latency"}}\n```
ana: you can see chunk2 starts with a comma and chunk3 begins a new top-level object. the validator expects a single JSON document and throws on the concat.
devin: interesting — non-quantized runs don't produce the comma between chunks. probably tokenization differences cause the model to emit a trailing comma in chunk boundary.
sam: I reproduced locally by throttling the stream. Parser barfs unless we coalesce chunks until braces are balanced or until we detect model declared function call.
mila: runner currently calls jsonschema.validate() on the joined buffer once any chunk ends with '}}' which is brittle.
ana: CI workaround from my side: updated runner to try incremental parsing with a 200ms wait-on-more-chunks heuristic. Fixed my local run but still flaky in CI where timings vary.
devin: can we instead rely on the model's function_call wrapper (the token-level annotation) instead of heuristic string boundaries? That should be robust across tokenization.
sam: that requires the eval harness to surface function_call metadata from the streaming API. right now the streaming client emits only raw text chunks. we can change it but it touches multiple callers.
mila: short-term fix: change validator to attempt two strategies: 1) try json.loads(buffer) 2) if that fails and braces unbalanced, sleep up to 500ms waiting for next chunk(s) in CI mode. Long-term: expose structured stream tokens.
ana: created a unit test that simulates interleaved chunks (including comma prefix) and added to ci-only test suite.
ci-bot: job eval-structured-ci re-run queued by ana -> https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/12346
sam: pushed a tiny patch that implements the two-strategy parse; opened PR #5123. please review.
ana: PR pinged. If we accept, we should also add a flaky guard and a dashboard alert so we don't ship silent regressions.
mila: agree. add metric: 'eval_runner_stream_reassembly_failures' -> grafana panel under 'eng-ml/evals'.
devin: also record model name + quantization mode on the metric so we can correlate.
ana: tagging @eng-ml for follow-up. thanks all :pray:
sam: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: job eval-structured-ci (12346) passed on rerun (quantized-4bit) :white_check_mark:
ana: marking this resolved in the thread, but leaving the long-term work item for structured streaming tokens.
